name: test-integration
title: Integration report
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Test a disposable copy of your setup, not your live workspace.
description: Audits and copies declarations, settings and extension files into a private core, then checks startup, registrations, recovery, cleanup and change scenarios. Runs asynchronously only when asked. Turning it off removes the in-app commands; the CLI remains available. Real agent profiles, rendering and performance are not covered.
